facts.text: Established in 1970 to focus on higher education for the Jewish community, Touro is the largest higher education system under Jewish auspices in America.

sources.title: About Touro | Touro University
sources.quote: Established in 1970 to focus on higher education for the Jewish community and humanity, we enrolled our first class in September 1971. Today, Touro is the largest higher education system under Jewish auspices in America.
